gates.name: Day-1 scope and exclusions
gates.closeWhen: Every EOS family is classified as Day 1, post-Day-1, pilot, or excluded; explicit exclusions are accepted.

gates.name: Commercial model
gates.closeWhen: Implementation, subscription, support, founding-customer treatment, change requests, and billable custom work are priced and accepted.

gates.name: Executed customer agreements
gates.closeWhen: Applicable subscription/service terms, implementation SOW, data/confidentiality terms, support terms, liability boundaries, termination, and data-return terms are executed.

gates.name: Data migration scope and rehearsal
gates.closeWhen: Source systems are inventoried, migration tiers and mappings are accepted, at least one repeatable rehearsal is completed, and exceptions are reconciled.

gates.name: Opening inventory reconciliation
gates.closeWhen: Opening warehouse, bin, truck, and serialized inventory is reconciled to an accepted operational baseline and Taylor records acceptance.

gates.name: Production identities and roles
gates.closeWhen: The production user roster is reconciled and each Day-1 persona is verified at least privilege against production authorities.

gates.name: Taylor administrative self-service
gates.closeWhen: Designated Taylor EOS administrators can perform ordinary Day-1 administration without source-code changes, CLI commands, direct database edits, or Verenward engineering.

gates.name: Day-1 workflow readiness
gates.closeWhen: Every Day-1 workflow has passed its applicable governed functional, sandbox, North Star, and acceptance gates.

PHYSICAL_CONSUMPTION_LOCATION_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED — OPEN Day-1 blocker, pending Owner ruling. A Work Order records consumption with no governed source location, so consumed stock stays in physical on-hand and Sales Order availability re-offers it (receive 5 / consume 2 still reads 5). NOT a code defect that can be closed by implementation: the custody model (WAREHOUSE<->MOBILE transfer, truck registry, bin_placements.pickedForWorkOrderId, serialized currentLocationId) all EXISTS and is governed; the single missing fact is which governed location a consumed quantity left. Every remaining route is a forbidden inference. Options A/B/C and a recommendation: docs/assessments/physical-consumption-location-authority.md. Pinned by functions/test/inventoryConsumptionOnHandGap.test.mjs and functions/test/consumptionCustodyBoundary.test.mjs. C1-PRODUCT-01 CANNOT be READY while this is open if the affected inventory/fulfillment path is Day 1.

PHYSICAL_CONSUMPTION_LOCATION_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED -> AUTHORITY RULED (Decision #168), IMPLEMENTED, NOT ACTIVE. A governed WORK_ORDER_CONSUMPTION movement, a source resolver (serialized custody -> unambiguous picked placement -> explicit selection -> refuse), and an additive correction that reverses to the original source are all merged and proven: receive 5 / consume 2 from Warehouse A = 3 and Sales Order availability sees 3; a truck consumption after a warehouse->truck transfer leaves the warehouse untouched (no double subtraction). PHYSICAL_CONSUMPTION_ACTIVE = false. SUCCESSOR BLOCKER: CONSUMPTION_SOURCE_SELECTION_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED -- a technician can read neither warehouses (admin/dispatcher or warehouse-assigned) nor mobile_locations (admin/dispatcher only), and updateWorkOrderExecutionData requires role === technician exactly, so the ruling fallback cannot be exercised. Activating regardless would refuse every consumption without a pick placement, and picking is optional. C1-PRODUCT-01 therefore REMAINS IN_PROGRESS: the defect is not yet closed in running behaviour.

PHYSICAL_CONSUMPTION_LOCATION_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED -> CLOSED_IN_CODE (Decision #168, PR #1772 / 616cda50). CONSUMPTION_SOURCE_SELECTION_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED -> CLOSED_IN_CODE (Decision #169). PHYSICAL_CONSUMPTION_ACTIVE = true. Proven end to end against the emulator through the real callable: receive 5 at Warehouse A, consume 2, physical on-hand 3, and Sales Order availability sees 3 -- closed through the canonical sumLedgerEligibleOnHand facts, with NO Sales Order-specific subtraction. Also proven: retry decrements once; no-source refused with qtyUsed and stock unchanged; consuming from a truck after a warehouse->truck transfer leaves the warehouse at 2 and never 0; pick default; pick ambiguity refuses then succeeds explicitly; explicit override preserves the placement; correction restores to the original source once. Technicians received NO general location or inventory read -- firestore.rules is unchanged and asserted, and the source projection returns identities and labels with no balances of any kind. STATUS: CLOSED_IN_CODE, DEPLOYMENT_PENDING. Not live-closed: sandbox is at 5eaa403a and the deploy boundary remains denied.

gates.name: Production security and authority verification
gates.authority: Verenward + Owner for protected production actions
gates.closeWhen: Production Rules, Functions, capabilities, roles, protected actions, tenant boundaries, and audit behavior are verified from the production environment for Day-1 scope.
evidence: Repository and sandbox governance evidence exists; production evidence remains required.

gates.name: Backup and restore proof
gates.closeWhen: Backup policy is defined and a documented restore procedure has been tested with integrity verification.

gates.name: Taylor interruption fallback
gates.closeWhen: Taylor has documented practical fallback/reconciliation procedures for critical Day-1 operations during an EOS interruption.

gates.name: Support and escalation model
gates.closeWhen: Official support intake, severity definitions, escalation, support hours/expectations, bug-vs-enhancement boundary, and third-party IT responsibility are operational and contracted where required.

gates.name: Day-1 training readiness
gates.closeWhen: Every Day-1 role/workflow has current training matching the deployed product, designated Taylor administrators are trained, and the permanent deployment training-close gate is operational.

gates.name: Cutover rehearsal and authorization package
gates.closeWhen: Source freeze, final exports, migration, reconciliation, user activation, smoke tests, fallback, and signoff are rehearsed and packaged for the final production action.
